title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
summary: Yes Bank has filed a petition with the Supreme Court to review an order from October 15. This order upheld a Bombay High Court ruling that quashed the bank's decision to write off AT-1 bonds. These bonds, worth Rs 8,415 crore, were questioned during Yes Bank's financial difficulties. The high court ruled that the bank's administrator lacked authority for such a write-off.

title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd has filed its Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering with regulatory bodies. This IPO features an offer for sale of roughly 66.18 crore equity shares from Coal India, amounting to a 10 percent stake in the subsidiary MCL. The intended capital raise is around Rs 9,500 crore, with the final execution reliant on regulatory approval and market conditions.
